ChangeLog: V5.5 Changelog -> No more whole different UI elements for settings of features, now all the settings will be hidden inside the feature and when you want to show them you just press the arrow next to the toggle, saving so much space and making the UI much more readable, this also allows me to make more settings instead of only the fully needed ones. -> Added Notifications toggle in Settings page so you can disable notifications sent by features if you want to. -> Added Save Settings Expanded State in Settings page. -> Side frame of the pages/tabs is now a little smaller so there's more room for actual content and less empty space. -> Updated Player ESP Visuals to match the script better and not look like a FPS game ESP. -> Teleport dropdowns such as NPCs Teleports now get their values auto deselected. -> Replaced the four shader buttons with a Shaders dropdown. Switching or disabling shaders now cleans up the previous shader. -> Improved performance of Random Auto Farm and Auto Quest. -> Improved auto reliability when enemies load or unload. -> Improved FPS Cap config behavior so default values do not force unwanted FPS changes. -> Anti AFK toggle removed from Misc page, it's now built in. -> Teleport dropdowns such as NPCs Teleports now get their values auto deselected. -> Selected values of Targets dropdown will now always be moved to the top. -> Moved No Clip to Character page. -> Removed Travel Speed sliders, speed is now the old default one (90). -> Removed unnecessary descriptions on some features. -> Configuration list dropdowns are now searchable. -> Updated codes list. -> Fixed autos sometimes stopping after resetting. -> Fixed multiple Auto Quest issues. -> Fixed multiple Fly Speed issues. -> Fixed some Punches/Ki Blast Aimbot issues. -> Fixed Entities Render Distance not applying to some entities. -> Other minor improvements and fixes.
